+def test_zero_size_input():
+    """Test that empty arrays are handled correctly in WCS transformations."""
+    # Create a simple WCS object
+    w = wcs.WCS(naxis=2)
+    w.wcs.crval = [0, 0]
+    w.wcs.cdelt = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.crpix = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.ctype = ["RA---TAN", "DEC--TAN"]
+    
+    # Test wcs_pix2world with empty arrays (list of arrays)
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert_array_equal(result[0], np.array([]))
+    assert_array_equal(result[1], np.array([]))
+    
+    # Test wcs_pix2world with empty 2D array
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world(np.empty((0, 2)), 0)
+    assert result.shape == (0, 2)
+    
+    # Test all_pix2world with empty arrays
+    result = w.all_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert_array_equal(result[0], np.array([]))
+    assert_array_equal(result[1], np.array([]))
+    
+    # Test wcs_world2pix with empty arrays
+    result = w.wcs_world2pix([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert_array_equal(result[0], np.array([]))
+    assert_array_equal(result[1], np.array([]))
